scene.description: Full-body poster illustration of a confident character walking toward the camera in slow-motion style, chaos and explosions behind.
scene.environment: Abandoned industrial district near Los Santos Docks. Fire from a recent explosion lights up shipping containers and graffiti walls; sparks rain down behind him.
scene.mood: Confident, gritty, cinematic; tension-filled mercenary vibe.

aesthetic.style: Rockstar Games GTA V poster illustration — semi-realistic stylized painting with cinematic composition, smooth airbrushed gradients, soft shadows, and bold visual contrast.
aesthetic.look: Realistic facial anatomy and proportions, slightly stylized clothing and environment, warm sunset palette, smooth tonal transitions, minimal flat vector effects, subtle stylization rather than cartoon.

lighting.description: Sunset orange and purple skyline casting dramatic side-light on character; subtle reflections from fire and sparks; maintain realistic highlights and shadows.

appearance.hair: Tousled blonde hair, realistic human texture, natural movement from wind and explosions
appearance.skin: Natural, slightly tanned, realistic skin texture

pose.type: Walking toward camera in slow motion
pose.action: Holding a duffel bag in one hand, weapon in other; walking confidently past explosion
pose.framing: Full-body centered, dynamic low-angle shot; sparks and fire blur behind

wardrobe.top: Black leather biker jacket with zipper details, slightly worn
wardrobe.bottom: Dark fitted jeans with subtle distressing
wardrobe.footwear: High-top sneakers or tactical boots, urban street style

accessories.weapon: Subtle GTA-style assault rifle or duffel bag full of gear

props_in_scene.background: Industrial shipping containers with graffiti, fire illuminating walls, sparks raining down, abandoned dock textures

camera_technical.requirements: Illustration in GTA V poster style — semi-realistic, cinematic painting, emphasize realistic human anatomy with stylized clothing and environment; avoid flat vector/cartoon exaggeration.
camera_technical.capture: Illustration composition — eye to slightly low angle; wide cinematic 16:9 framing.
camera_technical.composition: Hero silhouette centered with skyline and sunset gradient behind; car and railing forming diagonal visual anchors; balance between warm tones and dark clothing contrast.
camera_technical.retouching: Clean digital-paint finish; smooth gradients; subtle stylization; poster-grade cinematic contrast.
camera_technical.avoid: Cartoon vector style, anime proportions, flat color blocks, exaggerated facial features, text/logo elements.
